versions.changelog:
- Updated name to "Schema Sleuth" for consistency and branding.
- Bumped version to 1.0.3 in metadata.
- No changes to functionality or usage—documentation only.

- Updated the version metadata from 1.0.1 to 1.0.2 in SKILL.md.
- No functional or documentation changes beyond the metadata update.

- Updated author and version metadata.
- Added a homepage link to the skill metadata.
- No functional changes to schema inference logic or usage instructions.

- Initial release of phy-schema-sleuth: infer clean, production-ready schemas from 1–5 messy data samples in any format (JSON, CSV, API, plain text, LLM output).
- Output Pydantic v2 models, Zod schemas, TypeScript interfaces, JSON Schema (Draft 7), and Go structs with correct types, nullability, optionality, validation, enums, and nested objects.
- Pure inference engine: no external API required, works offline.
- Supports detection of dates, UUIDs, emails, URLs, enums, arrays, and complex/nested structures.
- Flexible trigger phrases and options for output format/naming. 
- Detailed skill usage guide and robust sample coverage in documentation.
